messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Trunc_Normal Distribution
parts:
That'll be insanely inefficient for truncations
any ways out on the tail.

One general approach to sampling

v ~ Foo(theta) T[L,H];

if we have cdfs and inverse cdfs is

u ~ uniform(Foo_cdf(L|theta), Foo_cdf(H|theta));

v <- Foo_inverse_cdf(u|theta);

This is also pretty inefficient and I'm guessing there will be
much better ways to do this for some specific distributions
and subcases.

Anyway, I still say we punt on this until we use
truncated normals.

- Bob
